dishes.make_ahead: Mix the dough up to 1 day ahead and leave covered in the fridge; shape, prove and fry on the day

steps.text: Mix the flour, the dried yeast, the sugar, the warm milk, the egg and the soft butter into a soft dough and prove 1 hour.
Roll into small balls, prove 20 minutes, then fry in the vegetable oil at 175C for 2 minutes until golden.
Roll in the sugar mixed with the cinnamon while hot.

dishes.make_ahead: Pipe the mounds onto the trays up to 4 hours ahead, covered in the fridge; bake just before serving

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C.
Bring the water and the butter to the boil, beat in the plain flour until it pulls away from the sides, then cool 5 minutes.
Beat in the eggs one at a time until glossy, then the grated gruyère, pepper and a pinch of nutmeg.
Pipe the small mounds onto lined trays, top with more gruyère and bake 22 to 25 minutes until puffed and golden.
Serve warm.

dishes.make_ahead: Rub the beef with the garlic, thyme and salt up to 1 day ahead and leave uncovered in the fridge; roast and rest on the day

steps.text: Rub the beef rib roast with the crushed garlic cloves, thyme and salt.
Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 45 minutes for medium rare, and rest 20 minutes.
Roast the potatoes in chunks alongside.
Carve at the table with the horseradish cream.

veg.make_ahead: Scrub, rub and wrap the celeriac up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast on the day

steps.text: Scrub the celeriac and rub with the crushed garlic cloves, thyme, half the oil and salt. Wrap each in foil.
Roast at 200C until a knife slides in easily.
Roast the potatoes in chunks in the rest of the oil alongside.
Unwrap, baste with the butter and roast until browned.
Carve at the table with the horseradish cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake and cool the layers up to 2 days ahead, wrapped; make the chocolate frosting, stack and add the candles on the day

steps.text: Beat the butter with the sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the self-raising flour, the cocoa and the milk.
Bake in two 20cm tins at 175C for 30 minutes.
Melt the dark chocolate with the butter, beat in the icing sugar, then stack and frost the layers and add candles.

dishes.n: Maple bourbon coffee with whipped cream
dishes.make_ahead: Whip the cream up to 4 hours ahead and keep it covered in the fridge; brew the coffee and build each mug to order

steps.text: Brew the strong coffee.
Whip the cream with the maple syrup to soft peaks.
Into each of the big mugs pour the maple syrup and the bourbon, then the hot coffee and stir.
Spoon the cream on top so it floats and grate over a little nutmeg.
Leave out the bourbon for non-drinkers.
Make sure everyone gets the right mug.

af.n: Maple vanilla coffee with whipped cream
af.make_ahead: Whip the cream with a little maple syrup up to 4 hours ahead, covered in the fridge; brew and pour the coffee to order

steps.text: Brew the strong coffee.
Whip the cream with a little of the maple syrup to soft peaks.
Into each of the big mugs pour the rest of the maple syrup and a few drops of vanilla, then the hot coffee and stir.
Spoon the cream on top so it floats and grate over a little nutmeg.
